paper.title: Solving the Hubbard model with Neural Quantum States
paper.authors: Yuntian Gu, Wenrui Li, Heng Lin, Bo Zhan, Ruichen Li, Yifei Huang, Di He, Yantao Wu, Tao Xiang, Mingpu Qin, Liwei Wang, Dingshun Lv

results.system_description: 16x4 rectangular lattice (Lx = 16, Ly = 4), periodic in both directions; U/t = 8, t' = 0; 56 electrons (28 up, 28 down), 1/8 hole doping
results.variant: NNBF with transformer backbone, MARCH optimizer
results.source_location: p. 31, text (Supplementary Sec. 4.1, 'our NQS yields a ground state energy of -0.76298')
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy of the transformer neural-network backflow state on the 16 × 4 periodic lattice at U = 8 and 1/8 doping, compared in the text with the HFDS value -0.753(2).
results.notes: No uncertainty printed. The paper's 8 × 8, 12 × 12 and t' = -0.2 periodic-lattice energies appear only as labels inside Figures S19-S27 and are not entered, consistent with the figure-only rule applied to other papers. Transcribed from the cited location of the versioned arXiv source and checked against the printed token; curator review pending.
